title: Zapium
body:
Description

Zapium is a relatively uncommon ore that can only spawn in Electrified Stone nodes inside of Electrified Meteor Crash Sites.

The raw form of Zapium is neon yellow with pulses of electricity emitting from the small nodes. When refined, it becomes a yellow foil material, and when forged, becomes a solid neon yellow.

It's raw and refined prices are currently unknown. When forged, it is worth around $65 a stud.

Like any other materials in the game, you can use refined and forged Zapium to complete schematics.
